rca of the issue: Transactions page crash — RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/Transactions.jsx introduced `onClick={() => setOpenSms(true)}` on line 64 and `<SmsParseDialog open={openSms} onOpenChange={setOpenSms} ... />` on line 152, but the corresponding `useState` declaration was never added. Since JS is lexically scoped, `openSms` resolved to undefined inside the render function, throwing ReferenceError which React converts into an error boundary → runtime error overlay in dev, blank crash screen in prod. Reproduction: login as demo → navigate to /transactions → see 'Uncaught runtime errors: openSms is not defined'. Fix: added `const [openSms, setOpenSms] = useState(false);` immediately after existing `open` useState (line 18). Verified: Transactions page now renders, txn-page-sms-btn opens dialog, parse returns 245/Transport for Uber SMS, save persists to DB and appears in list with budget-alert toast.
